in_sanskrit.name: Naorem
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Sky
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Naorem एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Naorem is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Narayana', which means 'Lord of the Sky'. It is a name that embodies strength, power, and courage, evoking images of the mighty Hindu deity, Vishnu, who is often depicted as ruling over the heavens.
